1.e4 c5 2.Nf3 e6 3.Nc3 a6 4.g3 b5 5.d4 c.strategy: Recaptures with the knight, which settles in the centre where it eyes e6, b5 and c6, and keeps the queen out of the reach of ...Nc6. The result is an Open Sicilian with Black's queenside pawns advanced and White's fianchetto set-up, so both sides play on the queenside.
